context: These lines are Astarion’s default in‑party chatter you hear while exploring — short, location‑or event‑triggered remarks that flesh out his history and react to things the party has recently done rather than advancing a specific quest. In these nodes he’s responding to having met a mysterious devil who seems to know more about the group’s situation; he’s suspicious, repeats that the devil is “playing with us,” and even notes other creatures (a hag) couldn’t solve their problem. He compares that manipulative behavior to Cazador Szarr, the vampire lord who once turned and tormented him — though many of these lines are flagged early in the game so the player does not yet know Astarion is a vampire. Some comments are blunt and situational, while others open up more personal detail as trust grows; party composition (for example Laezel’s presence) can tint the tone.
